newsitems.title: Giant Spotlight: Victoria
newsitems.author: ubi_anna
newsitems.contents: The Dream of VictoryA fierce, inspiring force who burns through the enemy ranks in pursuit of victory at any cost, Victoria wields the Angelflame to scorch the battlefield. Her marble-like skin protects her from the weapon’s noxious effects, but her elite crew enjoys no such immunity. To Victoria, sacrifice is simply salvation.AbilityNameDescriptionPassiveScorched AngelflameAttacks with Victoria's flamethrower spear also scorch enemies, dealing burn damage over time that can stackQBurning ArcSprays a widened flame, dealing damage in a coneWWinged VictoryDashing ahead, Victoria strikes all foes in her path. Increases her shield ESupercharged SpearVictoria's spear burns brighter, stunning the first enemy she hits and increasing her attack speed for a short whileUltOn History's PyreVictoria leaps into the air and lands on an enemy Giant, engulfing them in flames and stunning them In an ever-locked conflict, the people of Dawnline dreamed of a victory unbound by the tragedies of the war. As such she appeared to them. An angel of salvation.To choose Victoria is to choose inspiring, poetic deeds but also intense, hard-hearted sacrifice. Are you willing to give it all?

newsitems.title: March of Giants получила новый геймплейный трейлер - открытое тестирование пройдёт с 7 по 18 октября
newsitems.contents: Разработчики March of Giants представили новый геймплейный трейлер, посвящённый предстоящему плейтесту. В ролике показали игровой процесс, основные механики и Гигантов, которые будут доступны участникам тестирования, а также впервые продемонстрировали нового персонажа Пандемоса. Тестирование стартует 7 октября в 10:00 по EDT и продлится до 18 октября. Тестирование будет доступно игрокам из Северной Америки и ряда европейских стран, включая Латвию, Литву, Эстонию, Германию, Францию и Великобританию. Для участия необходимо запросить доступ через страницу March of Giants в Steam. Игроки, принимавшие участие в закрытой альфе в сентябре 2025 года, получат доступ автоматически. Также потребуется аккаунт Ubisoft и установленный Ubisoft Connect. Во время тестирования участники смогут получать очки за завершённые PvP-матчи. Победа принесёт 100 очков, поражение — 50. После достижения 1000 очков игрок получит статус "первопроходец" и награды, включая Пандемоса, специальную медаль и бесплатный набор для будущего раннего доступа.

newsitems.title: Our Vision for March of Giants
newsitems.author: ubi_anna
newsitems.contents: Our Vision for March of GiantsOur studio was founded six years ago and built from the ground up to make March of Giants, our take on the MOBA genre.From the very beginning, we knew we wanted to make a MOBA. We enjoy the unique design challenges, deeply engaged communities, and competitive spirit that define the genre. We also have tremendous respect for the systems that make them so rewarding to play: mastering a character, understanding the map and game flow, and coordinating with your team. Simply put, our goal is to make a game that delivers on the full MOBA experience.A World In An Endless WarWe looked toward the First World War and the industrial era surrounding it for inspiration, particularly its trenches, artillery, enormous armies, fortified positions, and shifting frontlines.Those ideas fit naturally with the structure we envision for MOBAs. Lanes become fronts to advance and defend. Soldiers become armies moving across them. Objectives represent territory worth fighting over.But we did not want March of Giants to be purely grounded in a historical setting. That industrial-war foundation is combined with a darker fairy-tale world that lets us move well beyond reality. Our Giants can draw from technology, folklore, experimentation, military history, monsters, and other ideas that fit within the world we've created.Giants are powerful combatants on their own, but they're also commanders within a much larger battle. Their influence extends beyond their own abilities through the Soldiers that fight alongside them and the Battleworks they deploy across the battlefield.Building on the Original VisionWhen we introduced March of Giants during our Closed Alpha in September 2025, it was our first opportunity to see how a large group of players experienced our game. We gathered as much feedback as we could, played countless matches with the community, and immediately began working to improve the game.To everyone who played in the Closed Alpha, your feedback was invaluable in shaping the future of March of Giants and making the game what it is today. We cannot thank you enough.The foundations of March of Giants will still be familiar to those who have played, but many of the systems around them have evolved. We've expanded the role Soldiers can play during a match, added more interaction and counterplay around Battleworks, and made the spaces between lanes much more important to progression and map control. Itemization has also been expanded to support more specialized builds and different ways to play each Giant.We've added new Giants, continued updating the returning roster, and made broader improvements across the map, UI, visuals, animations, game clarity, and many other parts of the game.Welcome, and Welcome BackDuring the transition to Ubisoft, much of our attention needed to remain focused inside the studio. Now we're ready to open the game again and bring players back into the development process with the Pioneer Playtest.We'll be hosting a YouTube Premiere on October 7, where members of the development team will give you a closer look at March of Giants and kick off the Pioneer Playtest. We're also reopening discussion in the official March of Giants Discord so players can reconnect, talk about the game, and share feedback throughout the playtest.During Closed Alpha, we said that PvP games are a conversation. Internal testing can tell us a lot, but it cannot replace seeing how players use these systems, what strategies emerge, and where we still need to improve.The Pioneer Playtest is our next chance to learn from you, and we're ready to see what you do with the game.Whether you were with us during Closed Alpha or are discovering March of Giants for the first time, thank you for joining us.We'll see you on the front.- March of Giants Development Team

newsitems.title: March of Giants' Pioneer Playtest Begins on October 7
newsitems.author: ubi_anna
newsitems.contents: The March of Giants Pioneer Playtest begins October 7 and runs through October 18, 2026. Whether you played in our first Closed Alpha or you’re joining us for the first time, here's how to get signed up for the playtest. The Pioneer Playtest Begins October 7The Pioneer Playtest opens on October 7 at 10 AM EDT through Steam. This playtest is open to players in North America and supported European countries, with servers available for both regions.We've added localization for English, French, German, and Spanish, with additional languages and server support planned for future playtests.Watch the October 7 PremiereWe’re kicking things off with a YouTube Premiere on October 7, giving you a closer look at March of Giants and what’s coming in the Pioneer Playtest. We'll be showing some gameplay, going over the basics of how to play the game, talking the Giants available in the playtest - including a new member of the roster, and giving you a peek at future of the game! How to Join the PlaytestIf you’re new to March of Giants:Head to our March of Giants Steam page.Click Request Access under March of Giants Playtest.Steam will notify you when access has been granted.Download March of Giants directly from your Steam Library.We plan to keep invitations open throughout the Pioneer Playtest. We are using this playtest to help us finetune our server capacity, so there may be periods where we may need to pause invitations to give us time to scale up our server infrastructure or hold invitations entirely.You’ll also need Ubisoft Connect and an Ubisoft Account to play. You can sign in or create an account when you launch the game.Feel Free to Share Your GameplayThis playtest will not have an NDA or watermark, so you can stream, record, and share any content from the game. We’re looking forward to seeing your matches, clips, streams, and hearing your feedback throughout the test. You might even spot the occasional dev in a match!Played in the First Closed Alpha?You're already invited! Everyone who played in the March of Giants Closed Alpha in September 2025 is automatically included in the Pioneer Playtest. You do not need to request access again, but it is important to note you will not receive a new Steam access notification at the start of the playtest. When the playtest opens on October 7 at 10 AM EDT, find March of Giants in your Steam Library, download it, and start playing. Returning players will also need to have an Ubisoft Connect account to play.The Pioneer ProgramWe want to recognize and celebrate the most active players throughout the playtest, so we are introducing the Pioneer Program. During the Pioneer Playtest, completing PvP matches earns Pioneer Points. Reach 1,000 Pioneer Points to become a Pioneer and unlock rewards during the playtest and Early Access.Pioneer RewardsPandemos: Permanently unlock our newest Giant when he arrives on October 12 - for this and all future playtests, and when March of Giants enters Early Access.Pioneer Medal: Be recognized as a Pioneer beside your name in every match.Early Access Pack: Receive a free Early Access Pack, including exclusive profile customizations, when March of Giants enters Early Access. Early Access date to be announced.Earn Pioneer PointsPioneer Points are earned by completing PvP matches:Win: 100 Pioneer PointsLoss: 50 Pioneer PointsOnly completed PvP matches award Pioneer Points. Leaving a match before it ends will not award points. PvE and Custom Games do not contribute to Pioneer progress.Progress Faster with a 20% Pioneer Point BoostPlayers can unlock a 20% Pioneer Point boost in one of two ways:Watch participating March of Giants streamers on TwitchJoin the official March of Giants Discord and claim a booster codeBoth methods unlock the same 20% boost and do not stack.With the boost active:Win: 120 Pioneer PointsLoss: 60 Pioneer PointsOnce unlocked, the boost remains active for the rest of the Pioneer Playtest.TwitchWatch participating March of Giants streamers on Twitch for 1 hour to unlock the 20% boost.Players must link their Twitch account to their Ubisoft account through Ubisoft Connect and watch participating streams while logged in to Twitch. Need information on how to connect your Ubisoft Account to your Twitch Account? Head to this support page.DiscordPlayers can also unlock the 20% boost by joining the official March of Giants Discord.After joining, head to the #get-pioneer-booster-here channel for instructions on how to claim a booster code and redeem it for the remainder of the Pioneer Playtest.You only need one code! The Twitch Drop and Discord codes provide the same benefit, so redeeming both won’t give you an additional boost.Where You Can PlayAustriaBelgiumBulgariaCroatiaCyprusCzechiaDenmarkEstoniaFinlandFranceGermanyGreeceHungaryIrelandItalyLatviaLithuaniaLuxembourgMaltaNetherlandsPolandPortugalRomaniaSlovakiaSloveniaSpainSwedenAlbaniaBosnia and HerzegovinaKosovoMontenegroNorth MacedoniaSerbiaLiechtensteinMonacoSwitzerlandUnited Kingdom...

newsitems.author: ubi_anna
newsitems.contents: Our next March of Giants playtest is right around the corner, and we have an update for everyone who has requested access through Steam.Everyone in our supported regions who had already signed up for the March of Giants Steam Playtest will be granted access to the upcoming playtest. newsitems.title: Closed Alpha Recap
newsitems.author: nickibre
newsitems.contents: As the Closed Alpha comes to an end, we'd like to extend a heartfelt thank you from everyone here at the Montreal Studio. Over the past two weeks, we’ve been thrilled to watch your streams, chat with you on Reddit and Discord, and enjoy the clips and discussions shared by players and creators. Our developers even jumped into countless matches alongside you to experience the fun firsthand.We’ve been especially excited to see players embrace the unique elements of March of Giants, from learning when to best use Battleworks to mastering the use of Soldier charges - watching how you experimented with these systems and developed new strategies has been one of the highlights of this Closed Alpha!Feedback & Looking AheadFrom bug reports and balance suggestions to fan art, everything we’ve gathered during the Closed Alpha will help guide the future of March of Giants. After the Closed Alpha, our focus will be on reviewing the data and feedback gathered as we plan our next steps.While we don’t have a date to share for the next test just yet, we’ll keep you updated. We are excited to make March of Giants the best experience possible, and your continued support is essential to that journey.As a reminder, players from the Closed Alpha will be invited to future public tests. However, Giants unlocked during the Closed Alpha will not carry over.Stay ConnectedWe encourage you to stay connected with us and with each other while we work on what’s next. You can follow us to keep up-to-date with game news and future development information:https://discord.gg/MarchOfGiantshttps://x.com/MarchOfGiantshttps://reddit.com/r/MarchOfGiants/Once again, thank you all for joining us for the Closed Alpha. We couldn’t have asked for a better community, and we look forward to sharing more with you soon!

newsitems.title: Closed Alpha Week 1 Recap & Expansion to Europe
newsitems.author: nickibre
newsitems.contents: Closed Alpha Week 1 RecapThank you to everyone who jumped into the first days of our Closed Alpha! Over these initial days, we’ve focused on testing our backend infrastructure, monitoring performance, and gathering your early feedback. We also rolled out our first update, aimed at improving overall stability and addressing key bugs. Now, we’ll be expanding the Closed Alpha by inviting players from Europe!Welcome, Europe!The Closed Alpha was originally limited to North America, but with strong interest from European players, we’re expanding to gather early feedback from that region as well. As with our initial launch, we’ll start small - limiting invites while we monitor performance, latency, feedback, and overall game experience before expanding further. European players will be routed to our US East servers during the Closed Alpha. We have been monitoring current European players within the Closed Alpha, and while not optimal, the latency to our servers is consistently within the acceptable range for matchmaking. To help reduce the impact of this increased ping, we are going to focus on sending invites out to areas with lower average latency. Dedicated European servers will come in future tests, but won’t be available during the Closed Alpha. Please note that only English localization is supported at this stage. It’s important to remember that the Closed Alpha is not a demo for a game about to be released - it is the first step in a long term roadmap for creating March of Giants. You may encounter bugs, rough balance, and unpredictable gameplay moments. All of this is vital to helping us shape development through your feedback. This Alpha represents just a portion of the content planned for full release.Share Your GameplayWant to show off your matches? Feel free to stream, record, and share your Closed Alpha gameplay - we can’t wait to see it!How To Join The Closed AlphaNot signed up for the March of Giants Closed Alpha yet?Visit the March of Giants Steam Playtest PageClick “Request Access”If selected, you’ll receive a notification email from Steam and will then be able to download the game directly from your libraryInvites are being sent in waves throughout the Alpha period. Keep an eye on your Steam notifications!

newsitems.title: March of Giants: Inviting Creators’ Feedback
newsitems.author: nickibre
newsitems.contents: Before Closed Alpha, we brought in eight seasoned creators from the MOBA genre for an exclusive hands-on workshop at our Montreal studio.A Creator-First Alpha InitiativeThis workshop brought together a focused group of players who know the genre inside and out. They stress-tested systems, broke down design logic, and shared insights that help sharpen our approach moving forward. We’ve always valued strong, informed feedback and creators bring a unique lens that complements the data we gather from internal testing, live play, and the broader community.What They PlayedDuring the workshop, creators went hands-on with core features, including:Giants – towering, player-controlled commanders with powerful abilities.Soldiers – troops that support your strategy and follow your lead.Battleworks – deployable war structures that enhance your position and defend key objectives.Days were split between PvP play sessions and open conversations with developers. From onboarding to moment-to-moment balance, nothing was off the table and no feedback was sugarcoated. “I wasn’t sure what to expect,” one creator said, “but I found myself wanting just one more match.”Why We Did ItOur development team make decisions guided by a clear creative vision, and informed by input from across the board creators, players, competitive benchmarks, and real-world gameplay data. We believe the best games are made with a strong perspective from within the studio and from the communities that care about the genre. That’s why we invited creators in early, to offer insight we can weigh alongside every other input we rely on.What’s Next?As we approach Closed Alpha, the creators who attended will begin sharing their experience, codes, concept art, and more.This workshop is one of many steps toward building a MOBA that rewards mastery, respects the genre’s legacy, and brings something new to the battlefield.Want to Play?You can request access for the Closed Alpha on Steam. Keep an eye on these creators for a chance to receive a code — availability is limited.Follow the creators:VarsWeak3nPinkwardMrsChimChimTrick2gLourloJenkinsMaryMaybeFor all the latest updates, make sure to join the official March of Giants Discord.

newsitems.title: Pillars of War - Creating March of Giants
newsitems.author: nickibre
newsitems.contents: We're Amazon Games Montreal, a studio founded five years ago by Creative Director Xavier Marquis and built from the ground up to make March of Giants, our take on the MOBA genre.From day one, we assembled a team of developers who live and breathe multiplayer, with a deliberate mix of backgrounds: some deeply steeped in MOBAs, others less so, to challenge assumptions. Amazon Games backed our vision for creating a MOBA early with trust, creative freedom, and a shared appetite for long-term, player-first development.Creative VisionFor Xavier, following a successful competitive shooter with a MOBA was a natural progression and a major goal as a developer. The vision was to tackle an extremely ambitious, fresh challenge with a new IP. MOBAs, at their best, are great to play, watch, and argue about — they invite competition. We wanted to take this experience and elevate it in a way that introduces new depth to the genre while still being approachable to players.We looked for a historical moment that maps to a MOBA’s core story: deep strategy, advancing waves, and well-defined objectives. We landed on the motifs of World War I — with its trenches, shifting front lines, and evolving terrain. That language makes match goals intuitive from a player’s perspective, with front lines to hold, reinforce, and capture on a dynamic battlefield shaped by conflict. It shifts the tone from classic heroic fantasy to something more grounded, focused on industrial-era technology like artillery and gunpowder.But this World War I inspiration is a tool to lay the groundwork for the game, not a design endpoint. To give players a role above the chaos of war, we created the Giants: characters that tower over rank-and-file units and dominate the battlefield. Born from the in-universe need to create a new super soldier, the Giants introduce an element of magic and fairy-tale to take us beyond the heavier tones of World War I. They provide a visual anchor in moment-to-moment gameplay and give players a clear identity in a chaotic war story.We envisioned Giants as commanders on the battlefield, and we looked for a way to merge this concept with the hero-centric perspective that makes MOBAs so compelling. This was the spark that led to the Soldiers: thousands of units for your Giant to guide on the battlefield, building pressure, and taking objectives.From there, we wanted to make the map itself more interactive. We looked to evolve the largely static arenas of MOBAs into a more dynamic battlefield in March of Giants. That led to the creation of Battleworks: structures and units that can be deployed anywhere to reshape both combat and the battlefield itself.What Closed Alpha Means to UsClosed Alpha is our first public step on the long road of developing March of Giants, and we’re encouraging players to talk about their experiences. To us, PvP games are a conversation; it’s important to both share and listen. We can test forever in the studio, but nothing replaces real players engaging with the game. When we sat down to define our ultimate goal for the Closed Alpha, we kept coming back to a simple ambition: exist. In a space this competitive, existence is earned by how players respond, not by what we say.Now comes the moment that matters most - the Closed Alpha is our first chance to connect with you, the players. Share your feedback and help us shape the future of March of Giants! Our ambition has always been to evolve the MOBA genre with new depth and fresh ideas, and this Closed Alpha is the first step in seeing how that vision resonates.-Amazon Games Montreal
